This comment was written by RepoMind, an automated triage agent. To reach a person, mention @ledgerline/maintainers.

Transaction amounts are stored as exact integers representing minor units (e.g. cents or yen) rather than floating point numbers, avoiding rounding errors. Zero-decimal currencies like JPY are handled explicitly by minorDigits/ZERO_DECIMAL in src/util/money.ts.

file: src/api/reports.ts
This comment was written by RepoMind, an automated triage agent. To reach a person, mention @ledgerline/maintainers.

In src/api/reports.ts, duplicating a report truncates `${source.name} (copy)` to MAX_NAME_LENGTH using `truncate()`, which replaces the trailing characters with `...` if it exceeds 120 chars. Instead of truncating the full combined string with `...`, slice the original report name to allow room for ` (copy)`, or validate/restrict the source report name length when creating/updating reports so that appending ` (copy)` does not exceed MAX_NAME_LENGTH.

This comment was written by RepoMind, an automated triage agent. To reach a person, mention @ledgerline/maintainers.

src/util/strings.ts uses slugify with regex /[^a-z0-9]+/g which drops non-Latin characters like Greek and Cyrillic when formatting export file names.
